Marco: Postmortem follow-up: we need short owner lines for the DR items (owner: brief action — ETA — one-line blocker if any). Paste exact line please.

Diego: Diego: owner: snapshot-chain auditor — action: add verifier that validates incremental chains and writes base-snap-id to metadata — ETA: 2026-04-07 — blocker: storage API change required.

Samir: Samir: owner: restore runbook & timing matrix — action: document single-AZ, partial-region, full-region restores + expected RTOs and checklist — ETA: 2026-04-05 — blocker: need reserved staging infra for drills.

Priya: Priya: owner: game-day ops plan — action: schedule dry-run, oncall rotation, blast-radius controls, war-room link — ETA: calendar by EOD — blocker: confirm staging capacity.

Marco: Noted. Two repeat patterns to call out in playbook: route drift during scale-up and restores failing due to broken incremental chains. Keep lines terse.

Elena: Added note: will include a small smoke test that simulates rapid scaler changes to catch route drift early.

Diego: Will PR the auditor and attach sample failing chain logs to the ticket.

Samir: I'll add a fallback checklist for manual restores if automated steps fail.

OpsBot: OpsBot: event "DR continuity dry-run" tentatively created 2026-04-08 09:00-12:00 UTC, playbook stub: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/continuity-dryrun.
